items.title: Fred Wesley interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 21, 2024
items.q: I remember Steve Gadd would play stuff that if you never thought to write, but he would just play things you know with the bass player... But he’d ask me, say, “Well where are the changes?” I’d say, “There are no changes here.”

ctx.x: But then a tune like “Down and Out in New York City” those had to be written out by me from what James Brown told me. James Brown would say, “Have the horns do this, he wants the flutes to do this, you know, ridiculous things you know. But I would make it work you know.
